about_the_game:
Centuries ago, the Eldritch Mists descended without warning, shrouding the eastern continent of Etherion.
Only cursed relics and death remained. Since that day, no one dared to set foot upon its haunted soil.Now, a lone ship carries the vanguard of the United Expedition toward this forbidden land—each member driven by their own purpose, yet bound together by fate. But do curses and death truly mark an end? Or are they merely the beginning of another, unknown journey?A quest to break the curse is about to begin.

Dominion of the Forgotten: Your Journey Begins

In Dominion of the Forgotten, you may embark on a solitary hero’s path or fight side by side with up to two companions. Whether you choose to brave the unknown alone or forge a team, every path offers a distinct and thrilling adventure.

Awaken Your Power: Growth Through Choice

As you delve deeper into Etherion, leveling up will unlock the secrets of a sprawling talent tree.
Perhaps you will walk the path of offense, awakening the might of the Yuheng bloodline;
or focus on defense, resonating with nature like the elves;
or take the supporting path, channeling the winds of freedom to shield your allies.

Each decision reshapes your skills and battle mechanics, making every encounter dynamic and unpredictable.

Explore the Unknown: Trials of the Cursed Land

From the ancient ruins of Crystal Reef Bay,to the blazing forges of Mount Fuenhuang,to the shadowed woods of Avendal Forest,you will face trials of every kind.Your courage will be tested, and the spoils? Not merely gear, but fragments of the forgotten history of the Cataclysm Age. Every victory brings you closer to the truth behind the shroud.

Forge Your Legend: Build the Perfect Gear

Will you wear the masterwork armor of the Yuheng smiths?Wield the ocean-forged blades of the Sharkfolk?
Or harness the lost artifacts of ancient magi?Create a combat style uniquely your own to face the shifting battlefields ahead. Craft your legacy, and make the curse tremble beneath your feet.

Together Through the Mists: Bonds in Battle

Two heroes, guided by destiny, fight side by side.
Their contrasting abilities weave together on the battlefield, creating endless strategies for victory.

But this is only the prologue. More heroes—each with their own mastery—will set foot on these lands, waiting to fight alongside you, to write a saga of friendship, sacrifice, and glory.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6400 / AMD FX-8320
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 960 / R9 280
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 10 GB available space

short_description: Dominion of the Forgotten is a top-down action roguelike adventure.You can choose to embark on a hero’s journey alone, or fight alongside up to three companions. Whether you prefer solo exploration or coordinated teamwork, each path offers a distinct yet equally thrilling experience.
